comment: MiniMax H3 text/image-to-video+audio, API format. Expanded from the official Comfy-Org video_minimax_h3 template (t2v/i2v share one graph: node 70 LoadImage -> first_frame is pruned by the MCP builder when no anchor image is supplied; image_clear=prune in the registry entry). MODEL edge chain: UNETLoader(6) -> PathchSageAttentionKJ(31, upstream class name really is typo'd; ~1.8x sampling) -> SpectrumApplyMiniMaxH3(30, conservative preset; do NOT stack EasyCache on top) -> scheduler+guider. 15 steps = community-validated quality parity with 20. Validated 2026-08-04 on a Vast 5090: 5s/124f @ 960x544 sampled in 83s (5.55 s/step). The executing Comfy lane needs ComfyUI >= e377e263, ComfyUI-Spectrum-MiniMax-H3, comfyui-kjnodes + pip sageattention (see packages/gpu-rentals/provisioning). Length is frames on the 17k+5 grid at 24 fps (124 = ~5s); the node snaps up internally. Node 30 runs the Spectrum degree-1 preset that ships as v0.1.8's own default (degree 1, warmup_steps 1, bootstrap_first_forecast true, tail_actual_steps 1) — the author measured 45% lower sampler time against Spectrum-off on H3 with no visible quality loss, because H3 (unlike WAN) tolerates a degree-1 forecast. We shipped the older degree-4 conservative preset until 2026-08-08, and when upstream flipped the bootstrap default to true our degree=4 graph started failing validate() with 'bootstrap_first_forecast requires degree == 1'; that was patched by setting the flag false, i.e. by opting OUT of the very feature. Every optional input here stays explicit — never inherit a Spectrum default — but keep them a self-consistent preset: validate() rejects bootstrap with degree != 1 or warmup_steps > 1, and the three trajectory modes (offline_smoothing_replay / anchor_residual_feedback / selective_rollback_correction) are mutually exclusive. offline_smoothing_replay is on and audio_blend_weight is 0.0 per upstream's v0.2.1 finding that a single pass at video=0.5/audio=0 reproduced degraded speech and stuttering — this graph's output is joint video+audio, so audio quality outranks the extra capture pass. Upstream itself says this preset 'prioritizes throughput' and is not established as universally quality-safe: re-listen after changing it. history_storage MUST be vram: measured 2026-08-07 on a 5090, same seed and shape (124f @ 960x544, 15 steps, warm), system_ram made Spectrum's forecast steps grow 13.6s -> 23.0s as its latent history shuttled over PCIe, so sampling took 133s and the whole prompt 301s; on vram the same run samples in 33s for a 183s prompt. Spectrum earns its place only on vram — with it off entirely, sampling is 44s. Watch VRAM if max_history or clip length grows: the history now lives on a card the H3 stack already fills. Sampler is euler, not res_multistep: measured on a 5090 at the same seed and shape, sampling 49s vs 64s and the frames are comparable (res_multistep is also the setting reported to cause artifacts and damaged audio with the H3 turbo LoRA). A KJNodes VRAM_Debug free once sat between the sampler and the decoders on the theory that the resident DiT was starving the VAE; measured on a rented 5090 it was a REGRESSION of 6-48s per job, because freeing models makes the NEXT job re-load and re-init them. Measured floor for this shape (124f @ 960x544, warm): ~40s of model init + text encode + video/audio VAE decode + mux, with sampling on top — so a 15-step clip is ~98s and even 4-step turbo is ~65s. VAEDecodeTiled cannot help: H3's packed latents make it fail with 'to() received an invalid combination of arguments - got (NestedTensor)'.
